review.imagery: Nineteen native project renders were visually reviewed against the official brochure and current gallery. They cover the buildings, balcony/courtyard pools, children’s play, cinema lounge, home interiors, lobby, gym, spa and hammam. Duplicate embedded resources, an isolated car layer and generic people/Italian landmark photographs are excluded. The complete two-building exterior supplies the card and hero. Proposed interiors remain unit-unspecific. No dated construction photographs or card badges.
review.floorPlans: Two complete home drawings come from the official brochure. Two building sheets come from a Mitchell’s Commercial Realty mirror of the SAMANA-branded plan pack. The floorplates distinguish two two-bedroom types, without a confirmed mapping to the generic home drawing. Numerical unit areas are absent. Confirm the approved unit, configuration and contractual area with SAMANA. The two complete official brochure home sheets on pages 34–35 and both mirror floorplates on pages 2–3 were visually reviewed. Store/laundry rooms drawn within the homes remain visible. Whole sheets preserve the north arrow, neighbouring-plot context, legends and unit keys. No area is inferred or separate missing two-bedroom variant invented.
review.location: Complete original brochure travel panel page 9 and regional map page 10 were visually reviewed. All eleven destination ranges match the current primary table. Its Rome by SD name-only query is saved with source hash. The broad schematic marker is not georeferenced. No nearby project pin, road distance or precise entrance is inferred.
review.provenance: Fresh primary HTML and original official brochure retain receipts, original bytes and SHA-256 values. Supplementary floorplates and comparison factsheet are broker-hosted. The selected pack is clearly attributed to Mitchell’s Commercial Realty. Native image origins, complete sheets and physical PDF links remain available. Protected text research is preserved.

unavailable: Numerical drawing-specific unit areas, confirmed mapping of the generic two-bedroom drawing to both floorplate types, a reliable plot/entrance coordinate, final approved fitout and dated construction photographs were not established.
